blocks.text: Your day likely involves juggling supplier invoices, flight confirmations, and hotel bookings. Excel is the tool that keeps this data moving. When working on a Mac, you need to be familiar with the unique keyboard shortcuts. For example, use ⌘ + T to quickly turn a range of data into an official table. This makes sorting and filtering much easier.
Common Excel tasks for travel planners

items: Consolidating expense reports from multiple departments.
Comparing hotel rates across different vendors.
Tracking travel policy compliance for global teams.
Organizing attendee lists for corporate events.

blocks.text: When you handle large sheets, navigation becomes a challenge. Use ⌘ + Arrow keys to jump to the edge of your data region. If you need to select a full column, press Control + Space. These small movements save minutes every hour. If you get stuck on a complex formula, ask Lazur to explain the syntax for you.
The Lazur advantage for your workflow

Lazur lives in your Mac notch. It sees your screen when you hold ⌥ + ⌘. This is helpful when you are staring at a massive, confusing spreadsheet. Ask Lazur where a specific tool is, and it will draw a circle around it. This is faster than searching through menus like Home > Conditional Formatting > Highlight Cells Rules.

items: Use [Data Validation](/how-to/use-data-validation-in-excel) to force consistent inputs for city names or booking codes.
Freeze your top row by going to View > Freeze Panes > Freeze Top Row so your headers stay visible.
Convert text to numbers if your expense data imported as strings by using the text to columns feature.
Use [Pivot Tables](/how-to/make-a-pivot-table-in-excel) to summarize spend by category instantly.

blocks.text: If you have a recurring task, such as formatting a weekly travel report, use the record macro feature. It saves your steps and replays them with a single click later.
blocks.title: Automate your reports

blocks.text: Many planners struggle with data consistency. When you pull reports from SAP Concur or other booking tools, the formatting often breaks. Use the clean data tools to remove duplicates and trim extra spaces. This prevents errors in your formulas later on. If you are unsure how to fix a specific error, hold your shortcut and ask Lazur to guide you through the repair process.

faq.question: Does Lazur edit my Excel files directly?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or edit files. It points at tools and guides you through steps on your screen.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur on Windows?
faq.answer: Lazur is currently built for macOS. A Windows version is planned but not available.

faq.question: How do I fix formula errors in Excel on Mac?
faq.answer: Start by checking your cell references. You can use ⌘ + T to toggle between absolute and relative references to ensure your formulas point to the correct data.
